name: Joss Marl
backstory: Thin as a ferry pole with a rope-hauler's long arms, Joss poles a flat ferry under the river wall and learned the Knot in Teo Varrow's warehouse. He slipped Ilk Venn to reach the 1491 semifinal and stumbled over the chalk against Tess Aldin, laughing on his back.
secrets: He ferries smuggled brimstone past the river wall by night.

relationships.name: Rosa Hollis
relationships.how: he claims Hollis descent; she denies it every year
